analyst_view.overall: Early view: AZ (14th, 6 points) are fifth in the Eredivisie and three points off the top after a 4-3 win over Groningen, while Sturm Graz (24th, 4 points) are fourth in Austria. Both play away on matchday 5 (AZ at Sparta, Sturm at Hoffenheim), so this view will change with those results.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. I lean a little lower: Sturm's European games have averaged 2.25 goals and they have scored three in four, two of them in the 3-2 home defeat by Celje. AZ have conceded twice at home in Europe (2-1 against Hapoel, 1-2 against Juventus), so 2-0 or 2-1 fits better than an open game.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners, 6.2 of them for AZ. AZ keep the ball well (they had more of it than Juventus), and Sturm were outplayed at Bournemouth, which fits a home-heavy split near the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards. Nothing in either side's European games points to a heated night, so I stay with the number until the referee is known.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.7 shots. AZ at home should create plenty, and Sturm will have to come out if they still need points, so I stay close to the site's figure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.3 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: AZ were blunt against Juventus and Sturm have only three European goals, so I expect fewer clear chances than the total shots suggest.
